notes.title: Major Update! 100 Asian Cats v2.0 available! COLORED Levels upgrade for FREE
notes.notes:
[h1]Meow! Long time no see! With Valentine's Day coming up, we’ve decided to update the game to make you happy.[/h1]

A big thank you for being with us and playing our games!


[h2]The 100 Asian Cats v2.0 update is now available! Enjoy colored version for Free![/h2]

notes.title: Trading Cards Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Trading Cards Update[/h1]

[h3]Hi everyone, we have some exciting news for you![/h3]

Now the game is more valuable, we got the Profile Features

[h3]Which means that:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now the game has collectible cards, badges, profile backgrounds, emoji
[*] The game can be added to the game showcase
[*] Achievements are now counted in the total meter
[*] Achievements can be added to the achievements showcase
[*] The game counts towards the perfect game list
[*] And some other things
[/list]

[h3]Unfortunately, you can get a trading card through purchasing an item:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/2667970/

*We cannot change this.

[h3]Also an update has been released for the game, but most of the changes are internal.
[/h3]
From visually noticeable changes:
[list]
[*] The main menu has been slightly redesigned
[*] Fixed some bugs during the game
[*] Fixed known bugs related to achievements
[*] Light tweaking for non-standard screen resolutions
[*] Cleaned up code, slightly improved game performance
[/list]

notes.notes:

[/list]
